categories.seoIntro: LaFuga – Fietsen en skeeleren in stijl. Designed by Ingmar Berga. Gemaakt voor mensen die nét dat beetje meer willen.
categories.seoFooterHtml:
Met LaFuga brengt Bergasports fietskleding en skeelerkleding samen waarin design, prestaties en kwaliteit centraal staan. Vanuit passie voor sport ontwikkelen we kleding die niet alleen goed zit en presteert, maar er ook onderscheidend uitziet.

Naast onze standaard collectie is LaFuga gespecialiseerd in het ontwerpen en produceren van kleding voor clubs, bedrijven en teams. Helemaal afgestemd op jouw wensen. Van kleuren en uitstraling tot pasvorm, details en design: samen creëren we een tenue dat echt bij jullie past.

We kiezen bewust voor goede materialen, het beste zeem en snelle stoffen. Want wanneer je prestaties telt, wil je kleding waarop je kunt vertrouwen. Of je nu op de fiets stapt voor een wedstrijd, training of lange tocht, LaFuga is gemaakt om te presteren.

Steeds meer bedrijven, teams en topsporters hebben inmiddels voor LaFuga gekozen. Onder andere Connected to Care, M2 Bouw, Nuvelstijn Mode en Okay Fashion & Jeans gingen je voor. Ook topsporters, waaronder Asia Berga, vertrouwen op de kwaliteit en uitstraling van LaFuga.

En die kwaliteit heeft zich bewezen: in onze kleding zijn al meerdere nationale titels behaald.

Van de eerste schets tot het moment waarop je jouw team in een uniek tenue ziet rijden: LaFuga is kleding met passie, karakter en een sterk verhaal.

Jouw team. Jouw stijl. Jouw LaFuga.

Benieuwd wat we voor jouw club, bedrijf of team kunnen betekenen?

High-end Road Bikes & Gravel Bikes from Orbea, Colnago, Cervélo, and Basso

At Bergasports, we understand that a bicycle is more than just a means of transport; it is an extension of your passion, performance, and style. Whether you are looking for the pure speed of the asphalt or the adventurous freedom of unpaved paths, our carefully selected collection of high-end road bikes and gravel bikes offers the very best the cycling world has to offer. With absolute top brands such as Orbea, Colnago, Cervélo, and Basso, you are guaranteed to bring home technological perfection and Italian or Basque craftsmanship.

Orbea: Basque innovation and versatility

The Basque brand Orbea is known for its innovative designs and excellent price-quality ratio in the premium segment. For pure climbers and all-rounders, the Orbea Orca is the ultimate machine: feather-light, stiff, and extremely agile. Are you looking for pure speed and aerodynamic advantage on the flats? Then the Orbea Orca Aero is your perfect match. For adventurers who want to combine comfort and performance on unpaved roads, the Orbea Terra is the absolute benchmark among gravel bikes. And with the Orbea Avant, you choose a comfortable endurance road bike, ideal for long, challenging rides.

Colnago: Italian passion and legendary heritage

Colnago is synonymous with cycling history, exclusivity, and unparalleled handling. Every Colnago is a work of art on wheels. The legendary Colnago V4Rs and the exclusive C68 represent the absolute pinnacle of carbon technology and design. For gravel riders who refuse to compromise on speed and style, the brand-new Colnago G4-X is the ultimate choice. With a Colnago, you do not just ride a bike; you ride a legend.

Cervélo: Aerodynamic perfection and pure speed

Cervélo is the brand for the performance-oriented cyclist who wants to optimize every watt. The Cervélo Caledonia is the perfect “modern road” bike: fast, aerodynamic, and designed for the most challenging roads and cobblestone sections. Do you prefer heading into the woods at maximum speed? The Cervélo Áspero and Áspero-5 redefine what is possible on a gravel bike. These are purebred racing machines built to break records, both on the road and on gravel.

Basso: Handmade Italian craftsmanship

Basso Bikes embodies pure Italian cycling culture. Handmade in Italy, with an extreme focus on detail, integration, and handling. The Basso Palta has become an icon in the gravel world, loved for its unique geometry that perfectly combines comfort with aggressive performance. Whether you choose the versatile Astra or the uncompromising Diamante for the road, with a Basso, you choose exclusivity and unparalleled handling.

Buying Advice: How to choose the perfect high-end bike?

Choosing a premium road bike or gravel bike is a personal process. When making your choice, consider the following aspects:
  • Intended Use: Do you focus purely on speed on the road (Orca Aero, Y1RS), are you looking for comfort for long rides (Avant, Caledonia), or do you want the flexibility of gravel (Terra, Palta III, G4-X)?
  • Geometry: A sporty, low riding position maximizes aerodynamics, while an endurance or gravel geometry ensures less strain on your back and neck during long rides.
  • Components: Choose the precision of electronic shifting (Shimano Di2 or SRAM AXS) and the reliability of hydraulic disc brakes for maximum control under all conditions.

Frequently asked questions about our premium bikes

How do I choose the right wheelset for my new bike?

The wheels largely determine the riding character of your bike. For flat roads, we recommend aerodynamic, deep-section carbon rims (such as the Scope Artech series). For hilly terrain or gravel rides, a shallower, lighter, and wider rim is often more comfortable and wind-resistant. We are happy to advise you on the perfect wheelset upgrade when purchasing your bike.

tree.seoFooterHtml:
Nimbl Cycling Shoes: Handmade Italian Mastery

In the pursuit of ultimate cycling performance, every gram and every watt you transfer to the pedals counts. For cyclists who refuse to compromise on weight, stiffness, and comfort, one brand stands head and shoulders above the rest: Nimbl. These handmade Italian cycling shoes represent the absolute pinnacle of the sport. At BERGASPORTS, we are proud to offer this exclusive brand to riders who settle for nothing but the best.

The Story Behind Nimbl: A Passion for Perfection

Nimbl was born from a deep-rooted passion for cycling and an obsession with technical perfection. While many brands have moved their production to low-wage countries, Nimbl remains resolutely committed to local, artisanal craftsmanship. Every Nimbl cycling shoe is entirely handmade in Italy. This not only ensures unparalleled finishing quality but also allows designers to apply the strictest quality controls. The heart of every Nimbl shoe is the monocoque carbon chassis. This ultra-lightweight and extremely stiff platform ensures direct power transfer from your legs to the pedals. No lost energy, no flex, just pure speed. It is therefore no surprise that more and more WorldTour pros and demanding amateurs are making the switch to Nimbl cycling shoes.

The Models: Nimbl Ultimate and Ultimate Stardust

Within the Nimbl range, several models immediately stand out for their groundbreaking performance and exclusive look. These flagship models are designed to perform under the toughest conditions.
  • Nimbl Ultimate: This is the benchmark for lightweight performance shoes. Weighing well under 200 grams per shoe, the Ultimate feels like a second skin. The combination of a superior fit, a breathable premium microfiber upper, and the unprecedentedly stiff carbon sole makes this the ultimate climbing shoe and all-rounder.
  • Nimbl Ultimate Stardust: For those who want to make a statement on the bike as well as perform, there is the exclusive Ultimate Stardust edition. This model combines all the technological highlights of the Ultimate with a breathtaking, shimmering design that reacts to sunlight. With the Stardust, you get a true work of art that radiates pure class and speed.

Why Choose Nimbl Cycling Shoes?

Choosing Nimbl is a choice for pure performance. But what truly makes these handmade cycling shoes unique compared to the established order?
  • Unparalleled Lightweight: Nimbl is among the absolute lightest cycling shoes on the market. This reduces rotating mass with every pedal stroke, directly resulting in less fatigue during long, intensive rides.
  • Maximum Power Transfer: Thanks to the handmade carbon shell sole, not a single watt is lost. Every pedal stroke is direct.
  • Sublime Fit: The ergonomic design fits perfectly around the foot, eliminating pressure points and maintaining comfort, even after hours in the saddle.
  • Exclusivity: Because the shoes are handmade in limited editions, you ride with an exclusive product that exudes craftsmanship and style.

Find Your Perfect Nimbl Shoes at BERGASPORTS

Choosing the right cycling shoe is a precise process. The fit must be perfect to prevent injuries and get the most out of your rides. At BERGASPORTS, we understand this better than anyone. As a specialist in high-end cycling products, we are ready to provide you with expert advice. Do you want to experience the handmade sensation of Nimbl for yourself? View our collection online or visit our physical store in Dedemsvaart for a professional fitting session. Our experts are happy to help you find the perfect size and the model that matches your cycling goals. Invest in your performance and experience the difference of Italian mastery.

tree.seoFooterHtml:
Scope Wheels: Groundbreaking Innovation and Performance at Bergasports

As a passionate road cyclist or gravel biker, you know that your wheels are the most important upgrade for your bike. They determine handling, acceleration, and aerodynamics. At Bergasports, we are always searching for the very best equipment to take your performance to the next level. That is why we are a proud dealer of Scope wheels. This Dutch brand, founded in the high-tech Eindhoven region, combines scientific innovation with an uncompromising passion for cycling. Whether you choose the proven R-series or the revolutionary, ultra-light Scope Artech wheelsets, with Scope you are guaranteed to ride with no excuses.

The Story Behind Scope Cycling: No Excuse

Scope Cycling was founded with a clear goal: to develop the perfect carbon wheelset for any terrain. The “No Excuse” philosophy is at the core of everything they do. Instead of relying on standard molds and components, Scope develops every part in-house—from the carbon rim profiles and unique hub systems to the specific spoke patterns. Through this holistic approach, Scope’s engineers succeed in finding the perfect balance between aerodynamics, stiffness, weight, and durability. Furthermore, all Scope wheels are tubeless-ready as standard, allowing you to benefit immediately from lower rolling resistance and increased comfort.

The Revolutionary Scope Artech Wheelsets: The New Standard

With the introduction of the Scope Artech series, the brand has turned the cycling world upside down. This is not just an upgrade; it is a technological revolution. The Artech wheelsets utilize groundbreaking technologies such as 3D-printed titanium hubs and a rim design inspired by nature (biomimicry). The rim features a unique ‘Aeroscales’ structure, similar to the skin of a shark. This ensures that airflow is optimally guided along the rim, resulting in unprecedented aerodynamic performance and minimal crosswind sensitivity. Thanks to the ultra-light carbon lay-up and the feather-light, 3D-printed hubs, an Artech wheelset weighs extremely little without sacrificing the legendary stiffness for which Scope is known. The Scope Artech is the ultimate choice for the cyclist who settles for nothing but the best.

The Scope Wheels Range at Bergasports

At Bergasports, you will find a carefully selected range of Scope wheels, tailored to your specific riding style and terrain:
  • Scope Road (R-Series & Artech Road): Designed for pure speed on the asphalt. Available in various rim heights (from climbing wheels to aerodynamic deep rims) so you can always find the perfect match for your favorite course.
  • Scope Gravel (G-Series & Artech Gravel): Specially developed to conquer the roughest gravel paths. These wheels offer a wider internal rim width for optimal support of wider gravel tires, ensuring maximum grip and comfort.
  • Scope Off-Road (O2): The ultimate carbon wheelset for the mountain biker looking for explosive acceleration and maximum control on technical trails.

Why Buy Your Scope Wheels at Bergasports?

Choosing the right wheelset is a bespoke process. At Bergasports, we understand this better than anyone. As specialists in high-end cycling, we provide you with personal and expert advice. We do not just look at the specifications of the wheels, but also at your weight, riding style, and the bike they will be mounted on. When you purchase your Scope wheels at Bergasports, you benefit from our professional assembly service. We ensure your new wheels are mounted perfectly straight, with the correct tires (tubeless or with inner tubes) and the appropriate cassette for your bike. Additionally, you can rely on us for excellent aftercare and maintenance, so you can continue to fly over the roads or gravel paths for years to come. Ready for the ultimate upgrade? View our full range of Scope wheels and experience the difference of Dutch mastery for yourself. Do you have questions or would you like to admire the wheels in person? Visit our store or contact our experts for personalized advice!
